title: Analytical Procedures (Assay IM1) [Assay][CP-6]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Assay IM1) [Assay][CP-6].

action.title: Column
action.description: Silica C18 3,5 µm 250 x 4.6 mm or equivalent

action.title: Test solution
action.description: Approximately 0.1 mg/ml of sample to be examined in diluent (Acetonitrile: pH 5.0 Phosphate Buffer (1:4)).

action.title: Reference solution
action.description: Approximately 0.1 mg/ml of CP-6 standard in diluent.

action.title: System Suitability Criteria
action.description: Theoretical plates > 3200  Reproducibility (n=5) < 0.73 %                                                                                        RSD of  ≤ 1% for n≥ 5 is desirable.

action.title: Calculation
action.description: The content of CP-6 is calculated according to the following formula: (Am*Cs/As*Cm)*V AM =   Peak area value of CP-6 in the test solution AS =    Peak area value of CP-6 in the reference solution CS =    Weight of CP-6 (mg) in the reference solution CM =   Weight of CP-6 (mg) in the test solution V =      Assay of CP-6 standard, in % Report the result “as is”.
